chapter: Chicago and Oliver's band in California
title: Garland's own band in Chicago
summary: After coming back to Chicago he led a band with Manuel Perez, Eddie Atkins, Lorenzo Tio, Frankie Haine and Louis Cottrell.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: No, not too much about them. Mm-hmm. I don't know quite a few of them. He left and come home back to Chicago. I hadn't played with me a while in Chicago.
All right. You had a good band up there?
I had a band. I had a band. Manuel Perez on trumpet. Mm-hmm. Eddie Atkins on trombone. Mm-hmm. Lorenzo Teal on clarinet.

Frankie Haine on piano. Louis Cantrell on drums. Well, you see his son on the boat on Wednesday night. You know that, huh? I won't see him on the boat. You're not going on that boat? No. You don't like the boat? No. Ain't got no money on that boat.
